headline: The New Zealand Defence Force says a discount-scheme database holding names and emails was accessed; its website is still offline.
summary: New incident page. Read the NZDF's own notice on nzdf.mil.nz (still the only page the site serves), RNZ (Nov 20 and the expert piece), the NZ Herald (Nov 20), Cyber Daily (Nov 23, with its own NZDF statement), a second RNZ story quoting the National Cyber Security Centre, and the govt.nz directory entry. Main answer Confirmed and answer_group hack-stated: the NZDF itself says there was unauthorised access and a database was accessed. incident_type breach. service down on c003, read at 11:30 PM ET. Size Local: one body's websites and one scheme's database. Open: how many people, which provider and how, who did it. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread; Reddit could not be read.
